name: Static Locked Camera
prompt: Use a static locked camera with no drift, no shake, and no reframing.

name: Slow Push In
prompt: Use a slow smooth push-in toward <Subject 1> with stable motion and clear readable framing.

name: Slow Pull Out
prompt: Use a slow smooth pull-out from <Subject 1> with stable motion and clear readable framing.

name: Arc Left
prompt: Use a slow smooth arc to the left around <Subject 1> while keeping the subject centered and readable.

name: Arc Right
prompt: Use a slow smooth arc to the right around <Subject 1> while keeping the subject centered and readable.

name: Full 360 Orbit
prompt: Use a slow smooth continuous full 360-degree orbit around <Subject 1> and return to the starting angle.

name: Tilt Up
prompt: Use a slow upward tilt from the lower body toward the head while keeping <Subject 1> as the focus.

name: Tilt Down
prompt: Use a slow downward tilt from the head toward the lower body while keeping <Subject 1> as the focus.

name: Tracking Forward
prompt: Use a slow forward tracking move that follows <Subject 1> with stable framing.

name: Handheld Light
prompt: Use very subtle handheld micro-movement only, keeping the shot stable and readable.
